caseName: Acosta-Febo v. Franklin Cal. Tax-Free Trust
caseNameFull: Melba ACOSTA-FEBO v. FRANKLIN CALIFORNIA TAX-FREE TRUST

opinions.text:
Motion of Fundacion Angel Ramos, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 15-233 granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit granted. The case is consolidated and a *583total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.

Justice ALITO took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
